profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Hey there! I'm a software engineer who's passionate about using software to help make the world a better place. I do full stack development, and I also do outreach at local K-12 schools, helping to reach underserved communities. I'm always looking for new opportunities, so if you have anything, please feel free to reach out!

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
- Developed custom software for education-based clients including an innovative afterschool dismissal platform (lbdismiss.com) that handles 1400+ students daily (Vue.js, with GCP Backend)
- Project Management - Agile development that brought customers and engineers together for on-time project completion, oftentimes exceeding clients’ expectations
- Pioneered our after-school and summer course program, providing computer science access to traditionally underserved students. Oversaw a team of instructors and teaching assistants.

positions.title: Software Systems Intern
positions.description:
- Maintained and enhanced internal asset management software that integrates with various high-impact research departments, enabling efficient maintenance and drastically reducing lifetime equipment costs
- Assisted in the development of an in-house Portfolio Management tool (.NET), enabling project information and details to be stored and presented in a unified format across the lab
- Worked directly with customers and management to ensure project needs were sufficiently met
- Engaged in agile development practices using Gitlab CI/CD and test driven development

positions.title: Solutions Engineer
positions.description:
- Supported the modernization of the State of Tennessee’s Child Welfare Administration solution
- Led design of specific solution components, collaborating with cross-functional teams scattered across the world
- On a daily basis communicated with clients, key decision makers, internal stakeholders, and the development teams to align on project goals and design requirements
- Prepared reports for management on project progress and continuously proposed opportunities for streamlining work and improving workflows

positions.title: Student Outreach Lead
positions.description:
- Exposed underserved students to STEM fields through engaging and interactive sessions. 
- Gathered student feedback and iterated new lesson plans to better engage future students
- Led college student groups on a weekly basis to prepare them for sessions in the field

company.name: The University of Texas at Austin

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin

volunteerExperiences.description: Taught and developed an all-encompassing Comp Sci 101 course that was designed to meet the gap in available courses at the local high school. Used experience from classes at Harvard University & cross-referenced university curriculum to create high-quality and effective lesson plans and assignments, ensuring equivalent rigor to AP Computer Science A. The course received much acclaim from both parents and students.
